title: erigeron nanus subsp. hungaricus
intro: Erigeron nanus subsp. hungaricus, commonly known as Hungarian fleabane, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron nanus subsp. hungaricus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic activities, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being studied, but it is known to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
